name: Mentions of Prophet Musa (AS), Shamwil (AS) and Daud (AS)

points.text: During the time of wandering for forty years, many of the people from that generation of the Children of Israel died.  During this time, Musa (a.s) and Haroon (a.s) also passed away.  Both of them could not enter into the Holy Land during their life in this world.

Allah sent another Prophet to the children of Israel and his name was Yusha ibn Nun.  He was an apprentice to Musa and after Musa (a.s), Allah appointed Yusha as the next Prophet. He led the next generation of the children of Israel and he led them into Jerusalem, to the promised land and they won over the Canaanites.

During the time of Yusha (a.s), there were many wars and the people had become were very weak.  After Yusha, Allah sent many Prophets to the children of Israel but the people were still becoming divided and weaker due to the many wars.

The pious people realized that they needed a king who could unite them and take them to the battle fields, and establish laws for all of the children of Israel as per the Tawrat. In this regard, we find mention of Prophet Shamwel (a.s) in the Quran and the incident of appointment of Talut as their king.

verses.text: Reminder is made about the children of Israel demanding to their Prophet (Shamwel a.s) that a king be appointed over them and they will fight in the cause of Allah. (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)
The Prophet (Shamwel a.s) replied: “What if you refuse to fight when you are ordered to do so?” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)
The people said: “How could we refuse to fight in the cause of Allah, while we have been driven out from our homes and from our children?” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)
Their Prophet (Shamwel a.s) told them: “Allah has appointed Talut (Saul) to be your king”. (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)
They replied: “How can he be our king when some of us are more deserving than he? Besides, he is not rich.” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)
The Prophet said: “Allah has chosen him to rule over you and blessed him with more knowledge and a bigger stature.” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)

Furthermore, their Prophet (Shamwel a.s) told them: “The sign of his appointment as a king is that there will come to you the chest in which there is tranquillity from your Rabb, the residue of relics which the family of Musa and the family of Haroon left behind, and that chest will be carried by the angels. Surely, therein is a sign for you if you are true believers.” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 32)

story.introduction: Allah’s test on the army of Talut

points.text: When the people accepted Talut as their king, Talut took his army and went for battle with Jalut (Goliath) and his army from the Canaanites.

verses.text: When Talut marched forth with his army, he said: “Allah will test you at a certain river; anyone who will drink from its water, shall cease to be my soldier.  And those who will not drink to quench their thirst except a sip or so from the hollow of their hands, shall fight on my side”.  (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)
They all drank from it, in spite of the warning except a few of them. (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)
When he and those who believed with him crossed the river, they said: “We have no power left this day against Jalut (Goliath) and his warriors.” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)

But the believers, who knew they would meet Allah, replied: “It has often happened that a small group, by the grace of Allah, has vanquished a mighty army.  Allah is with those who endure with patience.” (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)

points.text: The army of Talut had reduced to less than half of what they initially were. However, they were an army of believers who followed Talut and prayed in sincerity to their Rabb.

verses.text: When they advanced to face Jalut and his warriors, they prayed: “Our Rabb! Fill our hearts with steadfastness, make our steps firm, and help us (give us victory) against the unbelievers.”  (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)
They put the unbelievers to flight by the leave of Allah, and Daud killed Jalut. (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)

points.text: Daud was a shepherd and he was an expert in using his sling for throwing rocks or sharp objects with accurate and precise aim. He used his sling to throw a rock towards Jalut which hit his eyes and entered his brain to kill him.  Talut had announced that anyone who would kill Jalut, he would marry his daughter to him. It is mentioned in the Quran:

verses.text: Allah gave Daud the kingdom and wisdom, and taught him what else He pleased (reference is made to the Zaboor). (Surah Al-Baqarah : Section 33)

points.text: Therefore, Daud (a.s) became the king after Talut and he established the kingdom for the children of Israel and Allah made him a Prophet for his people.
